description: Header file defining the CoreWindowNativeWindow class and related handlers for managing ICoreWindow native window types in a Direct3D 11 WinRT environment, including event handling for window size changes.

classes.name: CoreWindowNativeWindow
classes.description: Class managing a native window for ICoreWindow, including initialization, swap chain creation, and size change event registration.

classes.name: CoreWindowSizeChangedHandler
classes.description: Event handler class for responding to window size change events.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the native window with a given EGL native window type and property set.

methods.name: createSwapChain
methods.description: Creates a swap chain for rendering with specified device, format, size, and alpha settings.

methods.name: scaleSwapChain
methods.description: Scales the swap chain based on window size and client rectangle.

methods.name: registerForSizeChangeEvents
methods.description: Registers for window size change events.

methods.name: unregisterForSizeChangeEvents
methods.description: Unregisters from window size change events.

methods.name: RuntimeClassInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the event handler with a shared pointer to the host window.

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Event callback invoked on window size change, updates the host with new size in pixels.
